title: Pineapple Punch
attribution: Greta Martin (Recipe Swap column, for Catherine Malcolm)
directions: Place in a large punch bowl: 2 cups strong tea; add and stir well 3/4 cup orange juice, 2 cups orange juice, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 cup sugar, leaves from 12 sprigs of mint.

Place all ingredients on ice for 2 hours. Shortly before serving strain the punch and add: 8 slices canned pineapple (juice included), 5 pints chilled gingerale, 4 pints chilled carbonated water, crushed ice.
notes: Newspaper clipping, RECIPE SWAP column, Calgary (Box 2400, Stn. M, Calgary, Alta, T2P 0W8)

title: Lemonade Syrup / Very Berry Essence
directions: === First card: Lemonade Syrup ===
Make this syrup ahead and store in refrigerator for up to two weeks.
Peel lemon zest thinly so as not to get any of the white.
In a small saucepan stir together zest, lemon juice, water and sugar. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Cool.
Strain into a bottle or jar and store in refrigerator.
Use 1-2 Tbsp. syrup per 1 cup (250 mL) water for refreshing lemonade.
Makes 20-25 servings.
=== Second card: Very Berry Essence ===
In a bowl combine berries, water and vinegar. Bruise berries by lightly pressing against side of bowl. Let stand at room temperature 8 hours, or overnight.
Strain well through a fine sieve careful not to allow pulp into the clarified juice. Measure juice.
For each 1 cup (250 mL) juice, add 1/2 cup (125 mL) sugar. Stir to dissolve.
Add 2 Tbsp. (25 mL) juice to 1 cup water or soda water for each drink.
Makes approximately 1 cup (250 mL) concentrate, enough for 10 drinks.
notes: Magazine/newspaper clipping headed 'COOL TASTES': Light and cool, key words for summer time menus. These make ahead recipes allow you to relax with the rest of the gang.

title: Unleavened bread
attribution: Fr. Dominic Garramone OSB, Catholic Digest Feb. 02, pg. 71
directions: Preheat oven - 350°.
Sift flour & salt into a med. size bowl. Stir thoroughly. Add oil & water & stir with a heavy wooden spoon - until a dough ball that comes away from the side of the bowl forms.

Turn dough onto lightly floured board & knead lightly for a min or two, until smooth. Divide into 4 parts. Flatten each piece with the heel of hand, then roll as thin as possible (less than 1/4" thick).
Place the rolled dough on an ungreased baking sheet

title: Gourmet Bran Muffins
ingredients: 3 cups health bran (not flakes or flour)
directions: In a very large mixing bowl, combine flour, bran, sugars, soda, powder, and salt. Stir in buttermilk, eggs, oil, and vanilla and mix until smooth. Add banana, raisins, and dates and combine.
Drop by the spoonful into greased muffin tins (do not over fill). Bake in 375° oven for about 20-25 mins or until tooth pick comes out clean.
Makes 3 dozen large muffins.
notes: Newspaper clipping, 'IN THE KITCHEN with Natashya Shewchuk'; left edge cut off, quantities for first five ingredients rewritten by hand in blue ink (1c, 1c, 3c, 3c, 1c)
Experiment by adding dried cranberries or chocolate chips
raw_text:
IN THE KITCHEN
with Natashya Shewchuk
Gourmet Bran Muffins
[W]ith summer nearly here, many people [li]ke to reach for something light but [w]holesome as they rush off to work or sit [o]ut in the back yard with a good book. [T]hese muffins are the perfect choice for [th]at afternoon snack, picnic dessert, or tea-[ti]me treat. Experiment by adding dried [c]ranberries or chocolate chips.
[In]gredients:
[1] cup raisins   1c
[1] cup dates - chopped   1c
[3] cups all purpose flour   3c
[3] cups health bran (not flakes or flour)   3c
[1] cup brown sugar   1c
1 cup white sugar
3 tsp baking soda
3 tsp baking powder
1 tsp salt
3 cups buttermilk
3 eggs - lightly beaten
1 cup oil
1 tsp vanilla
1 large ripe banana - mashed
Method:
In a very large mixing bowl, combine flour, bran, sugars, soda, powder, and salt. Stir in buttermilk, eggs, oil, and vanilla and mix until smooth. Add banana, raisins, and dates and combine. Drop by the spoonful into greased muffin tins (do not over fill). Bake in 375° oven for about 20-25mins or until tooth pick comes out clean. Makes 3 dozen large muffins.
